title: Predicting the Target Word of Game-playing Conversations using a Low-Rank Dialect Adapter for Decoder Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity of decoder models on a Target Word Prediction (TWP) task across different English dialects, specifically measuring the gap in accuracy and semantic similarity between standard American English (en-US) and non-mainstream varieties like Indian English (en-IN) and Nigerian English (en-NG).
